query:
SELECT 
  poi.id as item_id,
  poi.productId,
  p.name as product_name,
  poi.quantity,
  poi.unitCost,
  (poi.quantity * poi.unitCost) as total_item
FROM purchaseOrderItems poi
JOIN products p ON poi.productId = p.id
WHERE poi.purchaseOrderId = 480006
